Nepal Wire's take: One flood, four threads in Friday's news. The state will support five children until they turn 18. Their fathers went missing in the flood, Republica reports. A Malaysian is home after 37 days missing, Malay Mail reports, with 54 still out there. None of Friday's follow-up stories ask about the 933 people NDRRMA tied to hydropower projects on August 31. A Tikapur family has already stopped waiting for a body. Nepal owes the rest an answer too.
